ex.en: The service in this restaurant is none too fast.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳的服務一點也不快。

ex.en: Some national parks offer showers and even baby-sitting services.
ex.zh: 有些國家公園設有淋浴間，甚至還會提供托兒服務。

ex.en: There is an air service between Tokyo and Moscow.
ex.zh: 東京和莫斯科之間有航班往來。

ex.en: Train service will resume tomorrow morning.
ex.zh: 火車明天早上恢復行駛。

ex.en: By coincidence, these two are still being serviced.
ex.zh: 真巧，這兩台目前都還在維修。

ex.en: I need to get my car serviced.
ex.zh: 我的車需要送去保養。

ex.en: Promotion decisions consider performance and seniority.
ex.zh: 升遷決定會考量績效與年資。

ex.en: Her seniority gives her priority when choosing shifts.
ex.zh: 她的年資讓她在選擇班別時享有優先權。

ex.en: The seaport handles thousands of containers each month.
ex.zh: 這座海港每月處理數千個貨櫃。

ex.en: A new road will connect the factory to the seaport.
ex.zh: 新道路將連接工廠與海港。

ex.en: The broker specializes in government securities.
ex.zh: 這名經紀人專營政府有價證券。

ex.en: Investors moved their securities to a safer account.
ex.zh: 投資人將金融商品轉到較安全的帳戶。

ex.en: The software performs the tasks in sequential order.
ex.zh: 軟體會依序執行各項工作。

ex.en: Please follow the sequential steps in the guide.
ex.zh: 請依照指南中的步驟順序操作。

ex.en: The factory produces semiconductor chips for cars.
ex.zh: 這座工廠為汽車生產半導體晶片。

ex.en: Demand for semiconductor equipment remains strong.
ex.zh: 半導體設備的需求仍然強勁。

ex.en: Several passengers felt seasick during the rough crossing.
ex.zh: 海象不佳，幾位乘客在航行途中感到暈船。

ex.en: She took medicine before boarding because she gets seasick easily.
ex.zh: 她很容易暈船，因此登船前先吃了藥。

ex.en: The venue offers accessible seating near the main entrance.
ex.zh: 場地在主要入口附近設有無障礙座位。

ex.en: Please confirm the seating arrangement before printing the program.
ex.zh: 印製節目單前，請確認座位安排。

ex.en: Add the seasoning just before serving the soup.
ex.zh: 上湯前再加入調味料。

ex.en: The chef adjusted the seasoning after tasting the sauce.
ex.zh: 主廚試過醬汁後調整了調味。

ex.en: Fasten your seat belt, please.
ex.zh: 請繫好安全帶。

ex.en: Tom would still be alive if he had been wearing his seat belt.
ex.zh: 要是湯姆繫上安全帶的話，他就不會死的。

ex.en: Fasten your seat belt at all times.
ex.zh: 請隨時繫好安全帶。

ex.en: Employees who were laid off received severance pay.
ex.zh: 被裁員的員工拿到了資遣費。

ex.en: The company offered three months' severance.
ex.zh: 公司提供三個月的資遣費。
